answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed identity with decaying reputation: an agent must lock a small deposit and earn a trust signal through verified work before it can trade at full volume, like a falcon that must prove it can hunt before joining the flock. A grove of fake identities looks dense, but each one must separately pay the deposit and accumulate history, so mass forgery costs scale linearly while honest agents pay once. Misbehavior burns the deposit and poisons linked identities, making sybil farming unprofitable.
